text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Yo. Heard it's your birthday. Guess I'll 
celebrate it with you.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Celebration, huh. You plannin' on giving 
me a gift envelope or something?

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Heh, as if I'm the type to jump for joy 
over a reward. It's not that—it's a 
special kind of 'game.'

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Last time was poker, and the time before 
was billiards, so we're tied at one win 
each. In that case—

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Next up is baccarat. Bet it all on luck. 
Let's wager our freedom for the whole day 
against each other.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Betting it all on luck... huh.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
It's merely luck, yet luck is everything. 
Depending on luck, today could become 
either a blessing or a curse...

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
"...Heheh, haha, hahaha! I see, what a 
splendid game, truly fitting for a 
birthday!"

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Fascinating! All right, let us indulge in 
a feast of madness...!!

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Sheesh, look at you perking right up. 
You're probably the only one who'd be 
happy with a present like this.
